decisions.reason: Own web presence and two years of investment in an organic product that fits the announced strategy make management justify the earlier keep decision and attribute any weak results to temporary market timing.
As a premium product line with several models and public visibility since 2023, the firm has sunk substantial resources and will continue to justify its commitment rather than withdraw.

Launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page and public 'NEU' promotion, this organic product is central to the firm's organic direction, so early disappointing results will be seen as temporary and the product will be kept.
With several models and a dedicated page, this organic thin-sliced chicken line represents a visible investment in the organic assortment, so management will persist despite any weak early results.
Although newer and less invested, it has its own page and fits the organic core, so management will keep it and attribute any weak first-year results to launch timing.
